basic_details.short_information: The National Health Mission (NHM), Madhya Pradesh, has released the NHM MP Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026 notification for 301 contractual Staff Nurse vacancies under the Public Health and Family Welfare Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh. Eligible candidates can apply online through the MPOnline portal at iforms.mponline.gov.in. The application process started on 20 November 2026, and the last date to submit the online application is 5 December 2026. Selected candidates will receive a monthly contractual salary of ₹28,700.

content_sections.heading: NHM MP Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: The National Health Mission, Madhya Pradesh, has announced the application and correction dates for the Staff Nurse recruitment. Candidates should complete their applications before the deadline and use the correction facility, if required, within the notified period. The examination date will be announced through official NHM MP and MPOnline channels. The rulebook states that the e-admit card will be available approximately seven days before the examination.

content_sections.heading: NHM MP Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: The National Health Mission, Madhya Pradesh, has issued the Contractual Staff Nurse Selection Rulebook 2026–27. The 11-page document provides vacancy distribution, educational qualification requirements, domicile rules, age limits, monthly remuneration, application dates, CBT selection criteria, document verification conditions and the responsibilities of selected Staff Nurses. Candidates should read the complete official rulebook before applying. The rulebook is available through the NHM recruitment listing on MPOnline. View NHM MP Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026 Official Rulebook on MPOnline

content_sections.heading: NHM MP Staff Nurse Vacancy 2026 - Category-wise Details
content_sections.text: NHM Madhya Pradesh has announced 301 contractual Staff Nurse vacancies distributed among Unreserved, Scheduled Tribe, Scheduled Caste, Other Backward Classes and Economically Weaker Sections categories. The official vacancy table also identifies open and female vacancies. The notification also indicates 18 vacancies under horizontal reservation for eligible persons with disabilities. These positions are included within the 301 advertised vacancies and are not additional posts. Reservation benefits and applicable age relaxations are governed by Madhya Pradesh state rules.

content_sections.heading: NHM MP Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Applicants must meet the educational qualification, nursing registration, domicile and age requirements prescribed in the official selection rulebook. Candidates must satisfy all the following requirements: Passed Class 12 under the 10+2 education system with Physics, Chemistry and Biology as compulsory subjects. Completed a four-year B.Sc. Nursing programme from a recognized nursing institution, or completed General Nursing and Midwifery (GNM) followed by a two-year Post Basic B.Sc. Nursing programme. Possess valid and active registration with the Madhya Pradesh Nurses Registration Council. Important: GNM qualification alone is not listed as sufficient for this recruitment. Candidates applying through the GNM route must also have completed the required two-year Post Basic B.Sc. Nursing programme. The official rulebook states that educational qualifications will be considered as on the application commencement date, 20 November 2026. Candidates should ensure that they meet the qualification requirements within the prescribed eligibility period. Only candidates who are permanent residents of Madhya Pradesh are eligible to apply for the contractual Staff Nurse vacancies. Applicants must possess a valid Madhya Pradesh domicile certificate and upload it as instructed in the online application. Candidates from other states should note that the rulebook specifically restricts eligibility to Madhya Pradesh domicile holders.

content_sections.heading: NHM MP Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: The minimum and maximum age limits are calculated as on 1 January 2026. The notification provides a relaxation of five years in the upper age limit for eligible SC, ST, OBC, women and persons with disabilities, subject to the applicable Madhya Pradesh Government rules and domicile conditions. The official rules state that the upper age relaxation is available to eligible Madhya Pradesh residents. Candidates claiming relaxation must provide appropriate supporting documents.

content_sections.heading: NHM MP Staff Nurse Salary 2026
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will be appointed to contractual Staff Nurse posts under National Health Mission, Madhya Pradesh, with fixed monthly remuneration. The appointment is contractual and subject to National Health Mission service rules and applicable conditions. Candidates should not treat the stated monthly remuneration as a permanent government pay scale.

content_sections.heading: NHM MP Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection of candidates for NHM MP Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026 will be based on a computer-based online written test conducted through MPOnline, followed by the prescribed verification process. The recruitment examination will consist of multiple-choice questions based on the syllabus approved by the department. The rulebook specifies different minimum qualifying percentages for various categories. The minimum qualifying marks are not necessarily the final selection cut-off. Selection will depend on merit ranking, applicable reservation provisions, vacancies and other official conditions. NHM MP also reserves the right to reduce minimum qualifying marks if the required number of eligible candidates is not available. The official rulebook provides for 10% weightage to eligible Staff Nurses who worked for at least 89 days on a temporary or emergency basis during COVID-19. To claim this benefit, applicants must possess the prescribed experience certificate signed by the appropriate Chief Medical and Health Officer (CMHO). Certificates issued by other authorities or institutions may not be accepted under the notified conditions. The recruitment rulebook identifies the following cities as examination centre locations: Bhopal Indore Jabalpur Gwalior MPOnline may modify examination centre arrangements depending on the number of candidates and centre availability. Applicants may indicate their preferred examination centre while completing the application, subject to the portal's instructions.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for NHM MP Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must upload the prescribed self-attested documents while submitting the online application. Applications without the required documents may not be accepted. Class 10 marksheet or certificate for date-of-birth verification Class 12 marksheet B.Sc. Nursing or GNM and Post Basic B.Sc. Nursing qualification marksheets and certificates, as applicable Valid MP Nurses Registration Council registration certificate Madhya Pradesh domicile certificate Valid caste certificate, where reservation is claimed EWS certificate, where applicable Disability certificate issued by the competent authority, where applicable Other supporting certificates prescribed for the candidate's category or eligibility claim Candidates must also upload the reverse side of documents if relevant information appears on both sides. The rulebook requires candidates to possess the necessary documents by the application closing date. Applicants should verify document validity and completeness before submitting the form.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for NHM MP Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The NHM MP Staff Nurse online application form is available through MPOnline. Candidates can apply from 20 November to 5 December 2026. Visit the MPOnline recruitment portal at iforms.mponline.gov.in . Locate the National Health Mission contractual Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026 application. Open the application form and read the official instructions. Enter the required personal, educational, nursing registration and domicile details. Select the appropriate category and other applicable information. Upload the required self-attested documents and photograph according to portal instructions. Review the information entered in the application before final submission. Complete any applicable portal payment process displayed by MPOnline. Submit the application and verify that its status shows successful submission. Download or print the submitted application form and receipt for future reference. Important: Candidates must submit their online application by 5 December 2026. Applications through any other mode are not accepted. An incomplete or partially submitted application will not be treated as valid.

content_sections.heading: NHM MP Staff Nurse Application Correction 2026
content_sections.text: NHM Madhya Pradesh has provided an application correction window from 28 November to 6 December 2026. Applicants should carefully review their submitted details and make permitted corrections through the official MPOnline facility within this period. Requests for changes after the notified correction period will not be entertained under the rulebook's conditions.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies announced for NHM MP Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: National Health Mission, Madhya Pradesh has announced a total of 301 vacancies for the Contract Staff Nurse position. Candidates fulfilling the eligibility criteria can submit their applications online through the designated portal within the specified dates.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the online application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for NHM MP Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026 is 5 December 2026. Applicants are advised to complete their submissions well before the deadline to avoid any last-minute technical glitches.

faq.question: Q3. What is the required educational qualification for the Staff Nurse post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, Biology along with a 4-year B.Sc. Nursing or GNM with Post Basic B.Sc. Nursing. Additionally, candidates must possess a valid registration with the MP Nurses Registration Council.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The age limit for candidates applying to the Staff Nurse position is between 21 and 40 years as on 1 January 2026. Age relaxations are applicable for eligible category candidates who are permanent residents of Madhya Pradesh.

faq.question: Q5. What is the monthly salary offered for NHM MP Contract Staff Nurse?
faq.answer: Selected candidates appointed for the Contract Staff Nurse position will receive a consolidated monthly remuneration of Rs. 28,700 per month throughout their contract tenure up to 31 March 2027.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee details or charges have been mentioned in the official notification for submitting the online application form for the NHM MP Staff Nurse recruitment process.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for NHM MP Staff Nurse?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises a Computer Based Test (CBT) consisting of multiple-choice questions, followed by document verification and the subsequent preparation and publication of the final merit list.

faq.question: Q8. Can candidates from other states apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, only native residents of Madhya Pradesh are eligible to apply for the Contract Staff Nurse positions under the National Health Mission, Madhya Pradesh recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any negative marking in the Computer Based Test?
faq.answer: No, there is no negative marking for incorrect answers in the Computer Based Test. The examination consists of 100 objective-type questions carrying one mark each.

faq.question: Q10. Where can candidates apply online for this job notification?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online by visiting the official portal at www.mponline.gov.in or by using the direct application link provided in the important links section of the notification page.
